title: Cookies
body:
**Description**  
Does Open Web Analytics use Cookies?

You would think that in theory I could just look at my website, however I haven't got Open Web Analytics to work yet and I want to just launch my website before fixing the Open Web Analytics.  I've got other things to fix that take priority over this, but cookie warning are a matter of EU law, so the warning is more important than if it actually works or not.

So I need to write my cookie warning now, which means I need to know if Open Web Analytics uses cookies before I fix it.
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
